Zeta Parent Board Approves Spin-Off of Zeta NewCo

The distribution is expected to be completed on February 27, 2026. Zeta Parent shareholders will receive one share of Zeta NewCo common stock for every three shares of Zeta Parent common stock held as of the close of business on February 13, 2026, the record date for the distribution. Shareholders will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares.

Zeta NewCo common stock is expected to begin “regular-way” trading on March 2, 2026 under the symbol “ZZN”.
